key_highlights: ASX set to advance on Wall Street strength; Nvidia surges after $18B deal, lifting global tech sentiment
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price falls of up to 10%
Australia's economy narrowly avoids recession; GDP growth stalls while Canada's per capita output soars
Fourth RBA rate hike looms amid inflation concerns; AUD pressured by potential 'inflation rocket'
KPMG whistleblower scandal escalates: ASIC inquiry, political fallout, and high-flyer lawsuit dominate headlines
Persian Gulf tanker attacks and US-Iran tensions boost crude oil prices, supporting energy names
TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test hurdle
Data centre boom in Australia draws US caution; big tech faces community backlash

sectors.trend: Selective strength: Macarthur (MCR.AX) clears WA iron ore bulk test; Dalaroo (DLR.AX) expands African gold drilling; Lindian (LND.AX) secures 20-year Kazakhstan rare earths offtake; Critical Resources (CRG.AX) identifies NZ gold-antimony targets. Iron ore and gold exploration activity robust despite broader economic softness.
sectors.implications: Exploration and junior miners show resilience; large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face muted iron ore demand from China but rare earths and gold offer diversification. Macarthur's milestone supports mid-tier iron ore sentiment.

sectors.trend: CBA (CBA.AX) flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines. CBA and Westpac (WBC.AX) face scrutiny over loyalty-customer pricing loopholes. KPMG/ASIC inquiry adds regulatory overhang.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure likely as rate cycle peaks; credit quality risk rises with 10% house price correction forecast. Regulatory and reputational risk elevated. Defensive dividend appeal intact but growth outlook constrained.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy (TMK.AX) gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo (BTO.AX) faces gas cartel concerns; Persian Gulf tanker attacks and US-Iran tensions lift crude. Energy transition costs mounting as renewables scale (China solar passes coal).
sectors.implications: Short-term oil/gas price tailwind supports Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), and TMK. Long-term transition risk and community opposition to data centres (power demand) create mixed signals.

sectors.trend: Victorian healthcare system described as 'fundamentally broken'; Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting focus to tablet alternatives. CSL (CSL.AX) remains ASX's key healthcare anchor.
sectors.implications: Public health system strain may boost private healthcare and pharma demand. CSL.AX insulated from domestic system issues; global biotech volatility (Vertex, Novo) warrants monitoring.

sectors.trend: Nvidia Q2 results blow past expectations; $18B deal sealed; Cathie Wood adds 243K shares. Australia's data centre boom attracts US caution and community backlash. Dell beats on all lines.
sectors.implications: Global tech strength supports ASX-listed tech and infrastructure plays. Data centre power demand benefits energy and REIT sectors. Community NIMBY risk could delay Australian projects.

sectors.trend: House prices could fall 10% with fourth rate hike looming; home loan applications down 15%. EV adoption rising but hidden costs emerge. Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPG.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental pressure if housing corrects. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) benefit from rate-sensitive consumer pullback. Housing-linked credit risk elevated.

key_themes: RBA rate cycle: fourth hike risk vs. economy narrowly avoiding recession
Housing correction: 10% price fall forecast, 15% loan application drop
KPMG/ASIC regulatory scandal and political fallout
Geopolitical oil risk: Persian Gulf tanker attacks, US-Iran tensions
Data centre boom vs. community and energy transition backlash
AUD volatility on inflation and RBA policy divergence
Junior mining exploration momentum (gold, rare earths, iron ore)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce housing-linked REIT and bank exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, WOW.AX)
Hedge with energy exposure (WDS.AX, STO.AX); monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD
Monitor ASIC proceedings; avoid over-concentration in financials pending resolution
Shift toward quality earnings, cash-generative large caps; reduce cyclical exposure
Hedge AUD/USD exposure; monitor RBA communications and CPI data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy on geopolitical oil tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker attacks and US-Iran tensions support crude; TMK gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling

opportunities.recommendation: Selective junior mining exposure on exploration milestones
opportunities.rationale: Macarthur iron ore bulk test cleared; Dalaroo and Lindian expand exploration; rare earths offtake de-risks pipeline

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain CSL.AX as core healthcare holding
opportunities.rationale: Domestic healthcare strain supports long-term demand; global biotech volatility (Novo, Vertex) is idiosyncratic

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce housing-linked REIT and bank exposure ahead of rate hike
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price fall forecast, 15% loan application drop, and fourth RBA hike create credit and yield compression risk
Economic stagnation and rate pressure shift consumer spending to essentials; WES and WOW offer defensive dividends

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and monitor KPMG/ASIC developments
defensive_moves.rationale: Inflation-driven AUD spike risk and regulatory contagion in financials create tail risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open higher on Nvidia-led Wall Street strength, but gains capped by domestic housing and rate-hike fears. KPMG/ASIC inquiry adds overhang to financials. Energy names outperform on oil geopolitics. Expect volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: Economy narrowly avoiding recession but growth stalling vs. Canada. Housing correction of 10% could pressure banks and REITs over 6–12 months. Energy transition cost overhang and data centre community risk create structural headwinds. Quality large caps (CSL, BHP, WES) preferred over cyclicals.
